name: webrtc-datachannel-loopback-baseline
purpose: Measure a WKWebView WebRTC data channel as a direct peer transport without TURN
steps: Create two local RTCPeerConnections inside one WKWebView
Create a reliable ordered data channel before the initial offer
Exchange host ICE candidates with non-trickle negotiation
Echo bounded binary messages and record round-trip time
Close both peers and repeat negotiation to measure reconnect
